description: Ensemble des sujets relatifs à la feuille de route transition écologique - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data Orléans Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Ensemble des éléments de la feuille de route en faveur de la transition écologique et énergétique d'Orléans Métropole. Ces données sont issues des thèmes, idées fortes et actions/solution du manifeste et de sa feuille de route décrits en open data: Thèmes: / Idées fortes:: Actions/solutions opérationnelles:. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal files it under Environnement, Transition écologique. The portal shows 573 records. The portal shows 2022-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-orleans-metropole-fr-portal.
